notes: kb/Work PB5297 LANDED: the PARTIAL arm, DEBUG-SUB-n written as a subscript or reference-modifier position outside a debugging section, is refused COBOL6442 at --std 85: such a position is evaluated into a temporary by an operand-evaluation pre-op still pending when the statement funnel asks, so StatementBinder.ReferencesDebugItem now asks those pre-ops (PendingPreOps since the statement's mark) as well as the statement's own references. Witnesses: MOVE "A" TO TE (DEBUG-SUB-1) and MOVE W (DEBUG-SUB-1:1) TO V, each refused at its line. The row's earlier reading: §1985:XV.3.2.3 SR11: 'References to the special register DEBUG-ITEM are restricted to references from within a debugging section.' StatementBinder.BindStatement asks ReferencesDebugItem (BoundReferences.Of places whose item IsDebugRegister) of every statement outside a debugging section and refuses COBOL6442; that holds for a direct operand (MOVE DEBUG-SUB-1 TO W, DISPLAY DEBUG-NAME in a USE AFTER ERROR section, IF DEBUG-LINE = SPACES, DEBUG-CONTENTS(1:2) in an IF arm, COMPUTE over DEBUG-SUB-1), and DEBUG-ITEM with no debugging section or without WITH DEBUGGING MODE is refused COBOL1639/COBOL0901. But a DEBUG-SUB-n member written as a subscript or reference-modification position outside a debugging section is not refused: MOVE "A" TO TE (DEBUG-SUB-1), DISPLAY TE (DEBUG-SUB-2), MOVE TE (DEBUG-SUB-3) TO W, IF TE (DEBUG-SUB-1) = "A" compile and run, and DISPLAY W (DEBUG-SUB-1:1) / W (1:DEBUG-SUB-1) compile and abort EC-BOUND-REF-MOD at run time. The position read escapes the funnel's reference walk, although PB4858's landing paragraph says a subscript use is refused (its witness covers only a direct DEBUG-CONTENTS (1:4) operand). Fix owner: a new kb/Work defect (none files this). kb/Work PB5297 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-pipe/slice-69.json).

next.reason: 1985: "References to the special register DEBUG-ITEM are restricted to references from within a debugging section."; 2023: "No clause holds the feature; the 2023 USE rules cover only EXCEPTION, EXCEPTION OBJECT/CONDITION and BEFORE REPORTING, not DEBUGGING.". No 2023 clause holds the Debug feature, and the 2023 USE rules never mention USE FOR DEBUGGING or DEBUG-ITEM. The debugging section and its register are dropped.
